extracted.name: Eggs on the Grill
extracted.description: Have you ever tried eggs on the grill by using a muffin pan? Just spray the pan and crack the eggs and put them on the grill. Try adding some chopped peppers and onions or anything to your liking.
instruction_lines: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat.
Coat all holes of a muffin pan with cooking spray and crack an egg into each hole.
Place on grill and grill over medium high heat for 2 minutes, or to desired doneness.
